gloss: An international auxiliary language designed by L. L. Zamenhof.
Anything that is used as a single international medium in place of plural distinct national media.
A country in northeastern Europe, on the southeastern coast of the Baltic Sea. Official name: Republic of Estonia. Capital: Tallinn.
A state of the Southeast Region, Brazil. Capital: Vitória.
Any small, secondary, emergency-use vehicle used to evacuate from the main vehicle during times of danger.

A concentrated coffee beverage brewed by forcing hot water under high pressure through finely ground coffee.
A drink that includes espresso as an ingredient.
